title: Viewed-object identification from fMRI
disposition_reason: Public metadata-design and six-panel numerical retrieval-scoring components are available for the prospective within-person JPEG-RGB-1 condition. The complete participant adapter, authentic response/image joins, observation delivery and scientific execution remain unqualified; source availability does not establish any access-mode result.

scientific_target.question: Can a response from a held-out THINGS-fMRI image identify that image among a frozen candidate set within each measured person and independently selected ROI?
scientific_target.known_answer: The actually presented image identity, joined to its source trial/response and the fixed candidate-image roster.
scientific_target.answer_origin: THINGS-fMRI stimulus/event metadata and processed-response indexing. The published metadata-only builder constructs the protected query-to-image mapping and public roster; its join to authentic neural responses and image pixels has not been qualified.
scientific_target.case_unit: One person × ROI panel, with image responses as nested scored queries.
scientific_target.independent_unit: Three measured people; V1/IT and repeated images within a person are paired dependent observations.
scientific_target.inference_scope: Image retrieval from released measured fMRI responses in three people; the declared six-case successor is not held-person population generalization.
exclusions: No original-PNG fidelity claim for the JPEG-RGB-1 condition.
No hidden-data generalization, native LLM interpretation or successful numerical grading from a manifest.

inputs: Proposed selected within-person V1 or IT voxel responses and labeled training image-response pairs.
Frozen 3,700 candidate JPEG-RGB-1 images per declared case; candidate pixels are allowed while the query-image association is private.
forbidden_inputs: Query stimulus/image identity, original event order and answer-bearing file names.
Held-out neural labels or ROI/voxel selection using query outcomes.
observation_contract.case_identity: Six declared panels: sub-01_V1, sub-01_IT, sub-02_V1, sub-02_IT, sub-03_V1, sub-03_IT. The metadata builder constructs 1,540 opaque query IDs per panel and the scorer requires their exact ordering; authentic prepared IDs and response joins remain external and unqualified.
observation_contract.split: The source metadata builder implements within-person sessions 1–8 training, 9–10 development and 11–12 queries, globally excluding query and retained development images from training across all three people. This image-disjoint split is not concept-disjoint or leave-person-out; authentic source membership, response joins and train-only ROI selection remain to be qualified.
observation_contract.coverage: Published components require six panels × 1,540 query-image groups and 3,700 shared candidates, each score matrix [1540,3700]. Per panel, 1,640 presentations form 1,440 singleton groups plus 100 two-presentation groups. These are source-enforced support rules, not an authenticated observation delivery or a scientific result.

primary.name: Image retrieval Top-1 accuracy
primary.aggregation: Calculate query accuracy within ROI/person; report V1 and IT separately and equal-weight the three people within each ROI. A global mean, if used, must state equal ROI weights prospectively.
primary.rationale: Directly scores the measured stimulus identity without turning six dependent ROI panels into six independent people.

secondary: Mean reciprocal rank, Top-5 and full coverage by person/ROI.
Paired V1-versus-IT retrieval differences under the same candidate set.

comparators.name: Fixed training-only ridge image-response retrieval
comparators.inputs: Same labeled training pairs, voxel view and candidate images
comparators.procedure: Proposed: fit an encoding map on training images, then rank held-out responses against predicted candidate responses; freeze regularization on grouped training folds.

comparators.name: Candidate-prior and image-label permutation controls
comparators.inputs: Candidate roster; shuffled training image-response association
comparators.procedure: Proposed uniform/frequency priors and complete concept-grouped label permutation refits; no query target access.

nuisance_controls: Group repeated images and their exemplars across fitting/evaluation according to the frozen claim.
Freeze ROI/voxel reliability selection on training data; match candidate support across ROI contrasts.
Do not infer neural contribution from image priors or stable query order.
evaluation.uncertainty: Report all three person estimates and paired ROI effects; image/concept resampling is conditional on these people and cannot create population replication.
evaluation.failure_policy: Require every expected query/candidate ID exactly once and finite score arrays of the frozen shape; missing panels remain failures, never silently removed.

implementation.scorer_target: The published retrieval-scorer-v1 grades the complete six-panel prospective JPEG-RGB-1 retrieval condition: exact-tie expected Top1/Top5/MRR, separate equal-person V1 and IT summaries, paired ROI differences, and same-concept/singleton/repeat diagnostics. Its deferred-access entry point admits every submitted matrix before loading the protected mapping.
implementation.delivered_scope: Operator metadata-to-design/public-roster construction and numerical six-panel retrieval evaluation source. The registered-runtime manifest remains a source-only declaration; the participant adapter and all four observation/access modes remain unavailable.
missing: Recover and integrate the complete participant adapter and authentic observation delivery; the numerical scorer alone does not provide a direct, viewer, tool or programme episode.
Authenticate source metadata, response/trial joins, independent ROI masks, repetition aggregation and exact JPEG-RGB-1 candidate pixels under the frozen split.
Qualify complete source preparation, protected target custody and matched signal-derived/nuisance references on the declared panel; preserve the three-person inference limits.
implementation.execution_evidence: This revision inspects existing public source and corrects its discovery contract. The registered manifest still says not_run and execution_selected=false. No authentic inputs, participant episodes, model calls or numerical scoring were executed by this revision.

revision.source_review: Read the public metadata builder, retrieval scorer, their scope documentation and registered manifest. This source-availability correction retains earlier primary-source attribution; no new primary data, external paper, participant or model execution was performed.

holds.requirement: Qualify the existing six-panel retrieval scorer with authenticated observations, a completed participant adapter and independently checked references; metadata-only preparation is not authentic response preparation.
